businesses.business: infection prevention and procedural products and services

offering_description.value: STERIS supplies infection prevention and procedural equipment and consumables to healthcare facilities and to medical device, pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturers. It integrates operating room equipment, installs and maintains equipment, and provides outsourced reprocessing, instrument repair, laboratory testing and microbial reduction for medical devices.

quotes.quote: We offer our Customers a unique mix of innovative products and services. These include: consumable products, such as detergents, endoscopy accessories, barrier products, instruments and tools; and services, including equipment installation and maintenance, microbial reduction of medical devices, instrument and scope repair, laboratory testing, outsourced reprocessing; and capital equipment, such as sterilizers, surgical tables, and automated endoscope reprocessors, and connectivity solutions such as operating room integration.
MEDICAL DEVICE, PHARMACEUTICAL & BIOTECHNOLOGY MANUFACTURERS
